caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a lantern or a device with a handle. The device has a large, square, box-like body with reinforced edges and a top that flares out in a conical or stepped manner. Inside the box, visible through a transparent front, there is a small, vertical cylinder with a flame-shaped object above it, suggesting it is an oil lamp or similar light source. The box has shading and cross-hatching lines to indicate its three-dimensional shape and material texture, and is primarily rendered in black ink on a plain, light background. Attached to the bottom of the box is a cylindrical handle, shaded to suggest roundness. The overall composition is centered on the page, with the object occupying most of the vertical space.
